items.name: component-ui
items.title: NocoBase File Component UI
items.description: Application-owned upload, list, thumbnail, and preview components for business file endpoints.
items.docs: Install component-ui when an application needs editable file UI. Import its index.ts, create or pass a FilesClient for the consuming business endpoint, and keep route composition in the application. The item adds no route or server implementation. Review plugin upgrades with a three-way merge because installed files are application-owned.

items.name: page-ui
items.title: NocoBase File Page UI
items.description: Application-owned Demo page for the plugin's real attachments API.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-file and composes its stable public client API and components. The page calls GET /api/attachments/examples, then uses the returned endpoints for the Profile Avatar and Order Attachments clients. Its extension overrides the existing File Demo route component and does not declare another /file-demo route. The installed source is application-owned, is not overwritten by plugin upgrades, and should be reviewed with a three-way merge.
